newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends steady, seen supported at US$0.6900.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends steady, seen supported at US$0.6900.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended steady on Wednesday after trading a narrow range but with a neutral to slightly bullish tone.
The currency ended at US$0.6909/16 after opening at 0.6903/10 and striking a high for the day of 0.6919.
The Trade-Weighted Index was at 67.11 from its 67.23 open and the Monetary Conditions Index remained weak at minus 1.02 points.
"Kiwi is very well supported around 0.6900 and I suspect that it will still trade in that 0.6900-30 range," said one Auckland dealer.
Based purely on dollar block interest rates differentials, the Kiwi could go higher, he said.
"Of the dollar bloc currencies, the New Zealand dollar looks the most attractive. It's really hard to see it weaken given the weak MCI and the TWI," he said.
